title: OpenStack Cloud Configuration
description: Schema for a single, fully-normalized cloud configuration as produced by openstack.config after merging all sources and applying the 'magic_fixes' transformations. The reusable '#/$defs/cloud' subschema also tolerates the deprecated, pre-transformation aliases (tenant_name, auth_plugin, endpoint_type, external_network, ...) so that it can be reused to validate raw 'clouds' entries in a clouds.yaml file.

cloud.name: Cloud
cloud.description: Configuration for a single cloud. Additional properties are permitted because per-service overrides (e.g. '${service}_api_version') and plugin-specific auth options are open-ended.

auth_type.name: Auth Type
auth_type.description: Name of authentication plugin to be used

auth_methods.name: Auth Methods
auth_methods.description: List of authentication methods to attempt, in order

region_name.name: Region Name
region_name.description: Default region name for all services in this cloud

interface.name: API Interface
interface.description: Which API Interface should connections hit

cacert.name: CA Certificate
cacert.description: Path to a CA certificate bundle used to verify TLS connections

cert.name: Client Certificate
cert.description: Path to a client certificate for mutual TLS

key.name: Client Key
key.description: Path to the private key for the client certificate

insecure.name: Insecure
insecure.description: Disable TLS certificate verification (inverse of verify)

api_timeout.name: API Timeout
api_timeout.description: Timeout, in seconds, for HTTP requests to the cloud

force_ipv4.name: Force IPv4
force_ipv4.description: Disable IPv6 support and only use IPv4 addresses

prefer_ipv6.name: Prefer IPv6
prefer_ipv6.description: Prefer IPv6 addresses over IPv4 where available

networks.name: Networks
networks.description: Description of the networks available to this cloud

external_network.name: External Network (deprecated)
external_network.description: Deprecated. Use a 'networks' entry with 'routes_externally: true' instead.

internal_network.name: Internal Network (deprecated)
internal_network.description: Deprecated. Use a 'networks' entry with 'routes_externally: false' instead.

disable_vendor_agent.name: Disable Vendor Agent Properties
disable_vendor_agent.description: Image properties required to disable vendor agent

image_api_use_tasks.name: Image Task API
image_api_use_tasks.description: Does the cloud require the Image Task API

message.name: Status Message
message.description: Vendor-supplied message associated with the status field

status.name: Status
status.description: Lifecycle status of the cloud, as supplied by the vendor profile

baremetal_status_code_retries.name: Baremetal Status Code Retries
baremetal_status_code_retries.description: Number of times to retry on retriable baremetal API status codes

baremetal_introspection_status_code_retr.name: Baremetal Introspection Status Code Retries
baremetal_introspection_status_code_retr.description: Number of times to retry on retriable baremetal introspection API status codes

image_status_code_retries.name: Image Status Code Retries
image_status_code_retries.description: Number of times to retry on retriable image API status codes

vendor_hook.name: Hook for vendor customization
vendor_hook.description: A possibility for a vendor to alter connection object

auth.name: Authentication
auth.description: Authentication parameters passed to the keystoneauth plugin identified by auth_type. The recognised keys vary by plugin, so additional properties are permitted.

auth_url.description: URL of the identity service to authenticate against

name.description: Name or ID of the network

routes_externally.description: Whether the network routes traffic externally

routes_ipv4_externally.description: Whether the network routes IPv4 traffic externally; defaults to the value of routes_externally

routes_ipv6_externally.description: Whether the network routes IPv6 traffic externally; defaults to the value of routes_externally

nat_source.description: Whether this network should be the source for NAT

nat_destination.description: Whether this network should be the destination for NAT (i.e. where fixed IPs live)

default_interface.description: Whether this network is the default interface for the cloud

metrics.name: Metrics
metrics.description: Configuration for metrics and monitoring integrations

statsd.name: statsd
statsd.description: Configuration for reporting metrics to statsd

prefix.description: Prefix to prepend to reported measurements

influxdb.name: InfluxDB
influxdb.description: Configuration for reporting metrics to InfluxDB

measurement.description: Name of the measurement to record

timeout.description: Timeout, in seconds, for requests to InfluxDB

use_udp.description: Whether to report measurements over UDP

additional_metric_tags.description: Additional tags to attach to every measurement
